university.name: Arts University Plymouth
university.overview: A boutique independent arts university focused on contemporary crafts, design, and digital media.
university.admission_requirements: Portfolio review; IELTS 6.0; Relevant Level 3 creative subjects.
university.financial_aid: International Student Creative Scholarship; Materials grants.

courses.title: BA (Hons) Graphic Design (Top-up)
courses.overview: Refines professional practice and studio expertise for honours degree.
courses.modules: Professional Practice, Studio Project, Dissertation

courses.title: BA (Hons) Fine Art
courses.overview: Studio-centered course encouraging experimental practice across installation, sculpture, and digital media.
courses.modules: Studio Practice, Contemporary Theory, Professional Engagement

courses.title: BA (Hons) Game Arts & Animation
courses.overview: Equips students with technical skills in 2D/3D animation, character design, and engine art.
courses.modules: Concept Art, 3D Modelling, Character Animation, World Building

courses.title: BA (Hons) Illustration
courses.overview: Focused on narrative storytelling and personal visual language for commercial and editorial use.
courses.modules: Narrative Drawing, Digital Tools, Visual Research, Professional Portfolio

courses.title: BA (Hons) Graphic Design
courses.overview: Explores visual communication through typography, branding, and sustainable design thinking.
courses.modules: Typography, Brand Identity, Motion Graphics, Design Strategy

courses.title: BA (Hons) Fashion Design
courses.overview: Practical study of garment construction, tailoring, and conceptual fashion design.
courses.modules: Pattern Cutting, Garment Construction, Tailoring, Fashion Research

courses.title: BA (Hons) Film & Screen Arts
courses.overview: Collaborative filmmaking focusing on cinematography, directing, and experimental screen art.
courses.modules: Cinematography, Post-Production, Directing, Screen Theory

courses.title: BA (Hons) Photography
courses.overview: Broad photography degree covering documentary, editorial, and commercial practice.
courses.modules: Studio Lighting, Digital Workflow, Visual Literacy, Darkroom Practice

courses.title: BA (Hons) Textile Design
courses.overview: Focuses on material innovation through print, knit, and weave for fashion and interiors.
courses.modules: Print Processes, Weave and Knit, Material Science, Trend Analysis

courses.title: BA (Hons) Costume Production
courses.overview: Specialized training in the design and construction of costume for stage and screen.
courses.modules: Historical Construction, Millinery, On-set Practice, Costume Design

courses.title: BA (Hons) Interior Design & Styling
courses.overview: Creative reimagining of interior spaces with a focus on sustainable residential and commercial design.
courses.modules: Spatial Design, CAD, Materiality, Styling and Curation

courses.title: BA (Hons) Content Creation
courses.overview: New for 2026; focuses on digital storytelling, influencer marketing, and social media production.
courses.modules: Social Media Strategy, Video Editing, Digital Branding, Analytics

courses.title: BA (Hons) Craft & Material Practices
courses.overview: Interdisciplinary approach to ceramics, glass, metal, and wood with a focus on making.
courses.modules: Material Investigation, Studio Skills, Contemporary Craft Theory

courses.title: BA (Hons) Fashion Media & Marketing
courses.overview: Bridging fashion creative skills with business strategy and digital marketing.
courses.modules: Digital Marketing, Fashion Journalism, Branding, Consumer Behaviour

courses.title: BA (Hons) Painting, Drawing & Printmaking
courses.overview: Specialized fine art degree focusing on traditional and contemporary flat-surface media.
courses.modules: Technical Skills, Drawing as Practice, Printmaking, Art History

courses.title: CertHE Business & Management for Creatives
courses.overview: One-year certificate for developing entrepreneurial and management skills in the creative sector.
courses.modules: Entrepreneurship, Financial Literacy, Marketing for Artists

courses.title: CertHE Ceramics & Glass
courses.overview: Focused one-year program for building foundational skills in kiln-based arts.
courses.modules: Clay Work, Glass Blowing, Technical Safety, Studio Design

courses.title: MA Fine Art
courses.overview: Research-intensive master's degree for developing a high-level personal studio practice.
courses.modules: Advanced Studio, Critical Theory, Professional Engagement, Thesis

courses.title: MA Drawing
courses.overview: Explores the expanded field of drawing as a primary research and communication tool.
courses.modules: Experimental Drawing, Visual Analysis, Research Methods

courses.title: MA Design (Fashion)
courses.overview: Advanced study of fashion through the lens of sustainability and technical innovation.
courses.modules: Innovation Strategy, Sustainable Production, Fashion Research

courses.title: MA Design (Communication)
courses.overview: Strategic focus on visual communication and information design at a master's level.
courses.modules: Design Strategy, Brand Development, Visual Research

courses.title: MA Craft & Material Practices
courses.overview: Advanced material investigation focusing on the intersection of craft and industry.
courses.modules: Advanced Fabrication, Material Science, Research Thesis

courses.title: MA Museum Studies
courses.overview: Prepares students for roles in curation, conservation, and heritage management.
courses.modules: Curatorial Practice, Archive Theory, Public Engagement

courses.title: MA Immersive Media
courses.overview: Explores VR, AR, and interactive storytelling for digital creative industries.
courses.modules: Interactive Design, VR Production, Narrative Structures

courses.title: MA Painting
courses.overview: Dedicated postgraduate study of contemporary painting practice and materiality.
courses.modules: Advanced Painting, Critical Analysis, Professional Practice

courses.title: MA Glass
courses.overview: Specialized postgraduate study for artists working with hot and cold glass techniques.
courses.modules: Glass Production, Technical Innovation, Visual Research

scholarships.name: Creative Academic Merit Scholarship
scholarships.requirements: Must be classified as International for fee purposes; Minimum entry requirements equivalent to BBC at A-Level or equivalent; Submission of a digital portfolio demonstrating high creative potential; Acceptance of a full-time BA (Hons) offer.
scholarships.description: Awarded to incoming international undergraduates at Arts University Plymouth who demonstrate exceptional creative talent and academic promise. This scholarship provides a one-off tuition fee reduction in the first year of study to help foster global artistic diversity.

scholarships.name: AUP Alumni Progression Award — reviewed MA routes (2027/28)
scholarships.eligibility: AUP qualifying undergraduate, pre-degree or Foundation Diploma graduate; reviewed full-time MA.
scholarships.requirements: AUP confirmation for exact September 2027 intake/period, international fee status, offer, no other award combined.
scholarships.description: 15% of original annual tuition, conditional on saved verified applicant facts. Not an automatic award to all applicants.

rules.reason: Stored scholarship URL is outside AUP; verify university ownership, cohort and actual terms before any deduction.

rules.scope_note: Seven reviewed full-time September 2027 MAs. AUP must confirm personal qualification and applicability to the exact intake/period; no inferred combination with other awards. Historical application-page text names 2024/25.

eligibility_questions.label: Has AUP confirmed your international fee status?
Do you hold the offer for this exact September 2027 course and full-time route?
Have you completed an AUP undergraduate, pre-degree or Foundation Diploma qualification covered by the published Alumni Progression Award?
Has AUP confirmed that its 15% Alumni Progression Award applies to your exact September 2027 MA intake and compared tuition period?
Are you using this Alumni discount alone, with no other scholarship, bursary or fee waiver combined?

rules.note: Deposit is allocated towards tuition. AUP says no partial payments/payment plans for the remaining balance at enrolment. Confirm final payment instructions with AUP.

deposit_policies.source_text: Non-refundable GBP 2,000 deposit before CAS for applicants needing a Student visa. Included in tuition; balance in full at enrolment.
